description: Signals exist but feedback rarely becomes interpretation or change.
Feedback cycles support steady learning and responsible adjustment.
Fast reaction creates churn because signals are noisy and weakly interpreted.
Strong evidence interpretation systems thinking and learning memory.
Ethics accessibility and decision traceability are built into feedback loops.
Feedback is collected to signal responsiveness but decisions rarely change.
Operational signals are strong but user experience evidence needs depth.
Community feedback informs design with legitimacy and ethical governance.
